meta.title: nexa-render — HTML/React to video
meta.description: A platform to turn HTML and React into real video, with Playwright, Remotion and HyperFrames.

hero.description: A platform to turn <mark1>HTML</mark1> and <mark2>React</mark2> into real video, with <mark3>Playwright</mark3>, <mark4>Remotion</mark4> and <mark5>HyperFrames</mark5>, running <mark6>locally</mark6> or on <mark7>AWS</mark7>.

playReel.statement: nexa-render is an ever-growing platform with render engines and resources ready to use. Get access to the code and templates behind every recording.

slider.eyebrow: One engine, three ways to record
slider.title: Pick one to try.

playwright.title: Playwright
playwright.description: Records any HTML/CSS/JS as-is — the generic engine, ready from day one.

remotion.title: Remotion
remotion.description: React compositions — for when a template needs component logic, not just plain HTML.

hyperframes.title: HyperFrames
hyperframes.description: GSAP timelines — ported from the real POC, benchmarked at ~12-17s per 15s clip.

orbit.title: Technologies and render flow
orbit.note: This is what a live job looks like

steps: You upload your HTML, CSS or React
Playwright opens the browser and records
The worker dispatches it — local or on AWS

statement.title: One panel. Three engines. One result: your video.

panel.durationHint: Fallback only: media or code takes precedence.

engines.label: Engines
engines.title: 3 interchangeable engines
engines.description: Playwright records any HTML/CSS/JS as-is. Remotion and HyperFrames arrive in Phase 2, one for React compositions, the other for GSAP timelines.

workers.label: Workers
workers.title: Local or on AWS
workers.description: Start locally at no cloud cost. When you need speed, the same job runs on AWS without changing anything on the client side.

mcp.label: MCP
mcp.title: Native MCP
mcp.description: An AI agent can call render() and getStatus() directly — the same job engine as the REST API, no second implementation.

api.label: REST API
api.title: REST + Swagger
api.description: Every endpoint documented at /docs, generated from the same schemas that validate each request — never out of date.

docs.title: Swagger
docs.description: Every request and response, testable live.

templates.title: Explore the 3 templates
templates.description: One per engine, ready to edit and record.

platform.title: The platform
platform.description: Built by the same team that already automated video generation at Nexa Brief. Get access to the engine, the API, and the templates behind every recording — build, tweak, and make them your own.
platform.bottomDescription: We built nexa-render so recording HTML or React as video is as simple as writing the HTML.

reasons.title: Three reasons to use it
reasons.heading: Level up your video pipeline and join a workflow built to ship fast without losing quality.

items.title: One panel for three engines
items.description: No need to learn Playwright's, Remotion's and HyperFrames' APIs separately — one entry contract, the system picks the engine if you don't.

items.title: Local or in the cloud, your choice
items.description: Try it free on your machine. When volume demands it, the same job runs on AWS without touching the client.

items.title: Built for AI agents
items.description: Native MCP from day one — not a REST API with a wrapper bolted on later, it's the same job engine on both ends.
